ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark grey) to high-intensity (white) pixels; dark pigmentation dominates the central and left regions, with high-intensity pixels concentrated on the right lobe and trailing edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity (white) contiguous block on the distal right lobe tip. Extensive grey/black mottling across the left lobe. Symmetrical dark pigmentation at the peduncle insertion point and central notch region. Small high-contrast white focal points at both distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a calculated angle of approximately 40-45 degrees; deep vertical penetration relative to the lobe horizontal axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern along the entire trailing edge; peak-to-valley amplitude varies between 4 and 12 pixels; approx. 18-22 distinct serration peaks visible across the full span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex upward curvature on the superior edges tapering into sharp, acute lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast white circular clusters on the extreme distal tips of both lobes; scattered white focal points on the lower-left ventral quadrant.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three prominent, near-vertical dark linear streaks on the left lobe, intersecting the mottled background; one horizontal linear mark on the lower-left quadrant.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple parallel dark vertical rake marks on the left lobe; distinct scarring or tissue loss on the trailing edge serrations of the right lobe.
